parameters.name: sublayer_edge_velocity
parameters.justification: Mean velocity at the edge of the viscous sublayer, u(y+=5) = 5*u_tau = 5*0.19 m/s; held fixed so the wall shear change reflects only the slip boundary condition.

parameters.name: dynamic_viscosity
parameters.justification: Seawater dynamic viscosity at 15-20 C (rho ~1025 kg/m3 times nu ~1.05e-6 m2/s); converts the velocity gradient into wall shear stress.
